name: Test Skin
author: MediaPlayer3 Project
description: Starting point for trying out a new background-image skin without touching the plugin's own installed files -- copied into .mediaplayer3/test_skin/ the first time the program runs. Starts as an exact copy of Dark; replace the PNGs (and this file) with your own. See SKIN_ELEMENTS.md in the same folder for every element's position, size, font and colour.
